shorts.hook: Nobody opened the door on Halloween. Here's why.
shorts.spoken: On Halloween in Germany, many doors stay shut. Here's the rule nobody tells you.
Halloween only really arrived in Germany in the nineteen-nineties. Because of a war.
Before pumpkins, children in Germany carved turnips.

shorts.hook: A Halloween party in Bavaria? Check the law.
shorts.spoken: Planning a Halloween party in Germany? Check your state first.

shorts.hook: They race giant pumpkins as boats.
shorts.spoken: In one German town, people race giant pumpkins as boats.
